host: the platform on CellB in Node (packages/platform, dist/platform/cellb)

steps.title: Send the project as a ZIP
steps.note: The build runs in its BuildJob object, with esbuild-wasm. hono is not in the ZIP: it comes from the package store at the range package.json declares.

request.body: a ZIP of 4 files (2.4 KiB): package.json, public/index.html, src/index.ts, wrangler.jsonc

steps.title: wrangler.json: a no_bundle project
steps.note: main is the one bundled module; the Durable Object binding and migration are kept; assets point at the copied folder.

steps.title: worker.js: the project and hono in one module
steps.note: cloudflare:workers stays an import, for the host to provide. The host-compatibility entry wraps the default export.

steps.title: loader.json: the same build as a Worker Loader payload
steps.note: What env.LOADER.get(id, () => payload) takes: a host Worker can run the build by id, with no deploy.

steps.title: The same inputs again
steps.note: A build id is the hash of the builder version, the inputs and the spec: the finished build is returned, not made again.

steps.title: Run the output: the static page
steps.note: project.zip, unpacked and started on CellB in Node (wrangler dev and celld dev run the same folder).
steps.curl:
curl -o build.zip http://localhost:8787/b/3415358ffa32017bce4c/project.zip && unzip build.zip -d build
npx tsx packages/platform/scripts/serve-cellb.mjs build --port 8788
curl http://localhost:8788/
